articles.title: SignDino: Self-Supervised Sign Language Representation Learning via Temporal-Axis Self-Distillation
articles.abstract: Self-supervised sign language representation learning must model two properties not central to natural-image SSL: signs are produced by a small set of anatomically distinct articulators, and their meaning depends on the temporal organisation of those articulators. We introduce SignDino, a self-supervised sign-video encoder that moves the DINOv3 student--teacher recipe from the spatial domain of image crops to the temporal domain of tracked sign streams. Each video is decomposed into left-hand, right-hand, and face streams by a detector-first YOLOv8n+ByteTrack pipeline. A frozen DINOv3 ViT-B/16 embeds each per-frame anatomical crop, while lightweight temporal Transformers, not the image backbone, form the student and EMA teacher. They are trained by temporal DINO self-distillation, frame-level masked-token prediction in the style of iBOT, KoLeo feature spreading, and Gram anchoring of the frame-to-frame similarity structure. This design keeps strong image-level visual primitives fixed and learns only how articulator states evolve across time. We evaluate on sign-to-English translation, isolated sign recognition, and fingerspelling detection benchmarks. Across these tasks, SignDino provides a strong public self-supervised representation and shows competitive or state-of-the-art performance under matched downstream evaluation.
articles.titleCn: SignDino：基于时间轴自蒸馏的无监督手语表征学习
articles.abstractCn: 自监督手语表征学习必须建模两个不属于自然图像SSL的核心特性：手语由少数解剖学上不同的发音器官产生，其含义取决于这些发音器官的时间组织。我们引入了SignDino，一种自监督手语视频编码器，将DINOv3师生学习配方从图像裁剪的空间域迁移到跟踪手语流的时间域。每个视频通过检测优先的YOLOv8n+ByteTrack流程分解为左手、右手和面部流。冻结的DINOv3 ViT-B/16嵌入每帧的解剖学裁剪，而轻量级的时间Transformer（而非图像主干）形成师生和EMA教师。它们通过时间DINO自蒸馏、类似iBOT的帧级掩码标记预测、KoLeo特征扩散和帧间相似性结构的Gram锚定进行训练。该设计保持强图像级视觉原语固定，仅学习发音器官状态随时间演变的方式。我们在手语到英语翻译、孤立手语识别和手指拼写检测基准上进行了评估。在这些任务中，SignDino提供了一个强大的公共自监督表征，并在匹配的下游评估中展现出具有竞争力的或最先进的性能。

articles.title: Steering Geometry: Validating Human Value Geometry in LLM Steering Space
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in alignment-sensitive contexts, activation steering has emerged as a lightweight, inference-time alternative to fine-tuning methods (e.g., RLHF, DPO) for behavioral control. However, existing work typically validates steering on isolated behaviors, leaving it unclear whether steering vectors encode coherent semantic structure or merely exploit behavior-specific shortcuts. We investigate whether the latent geometry of LLM steering vectors reflects theory-specified structure in human values and morality. Using Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values as our primary fine-grained framework, we introduce a 26K-sample benchmark covering 20 human values and analyze distribution-driven methods (e.g., CAA, SphericalSteer, ODESteer) and behavior-centric approaches (e.g., COLD-Steer, BiPO) across diverse model families and sizes. We find that distribution-driven methods recover human value topologies aligned with theoretical predictions (Spearman $ρ$ up to 0.51, $p < 10^{-13}$). In contrast, behavior-centric methods achieve comparable steering performance but show little correlation with the expected value geometry. Geometric fidelity improves with model scale but drops after instruction tuning. Finally, better geometric alignment also leads to more human-consistent transfer across values: steering one value correctly lifts compatible values and suppresses opposing ones. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/DeepRCL/Steering_Geometry.
articles.titleCn: 转向几何：验证LLM转向空间中的人类价值几何
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于对一致性敏感的语境中，激活引导已成为一种轻量级、推理时替代微调方法（例如，RLHF、DPO）的行为控制方案。然而，现有工作通常在孤立的行为上验证引导效果，导致尚不清楚引导向量是否编码了连贯的语义结构，还是仅仅利用了行为特定的捷径。我们研究了LLM引导向量的潜在几何结构是否反映了人类价值观和道德中理论指定的结构。以施瓦茨的基本人类价值观理论作为主要的细粒度框架，我们引入了一个包含20种人类价值观的26K样本基准，并分析了分布驱动方法（例如，CAA、SphericalSteer、ODESteer）和行为中心方法（例如，COLD-Steer、BiPO）在不同模型家族和规模下的表现。我们发现，分布驱动方法恢复的人类价值观拓扑结构与理论预测相符（Spearman $ρ$最高达0.51，$p < 10^{-13}$）。相比之下，行为中心方法实现了相当的行为引导性能，但与预期的价值观几何结构几乎没有相关性。几何保真度随着模型规模提升而提高，但在指令微调后会下降。最后，更好的几何一致性也带来了跨价值观更符合人类一致性的迁移效果：正确引导一种价值观能够提升兼容价值观并抑制对立价值观。代码和数据可在：https://github.com/DeepRCL/Steering_Geometry获取。

articles.title: Correction as Annotation: Bootstrapping a Dependency Parser for Documentary Medieval Latin
articles.abstract: Medieval documentary sources remain inadequately served by existing natural language processing tools. None of the five readily available Latin treebank models attains usable performance on a collection of 160 inventories compiled in Marseille between 1258 and 1446. The best labelled attachment score is 0.62 and the best morphology-aware score is 0.24. Performance does not correlate with either genre or period proximity. To address this shortfall, in-domain training data was generated as a by-product of using these inadequate models. In each of nine iterations, a model pre-annotated 200 sentences; an expert corrected the annotations; and the corrected sentences were used to train the subsequent model, with batches sampled independently of model state, without active-learning selection. Thirty-three hours of annotation effort over 1,804 sentences increased universal part-of-speech accuracy from 0.80 to 0.98 and labelled attachment from 0.48 to 0.92, outperforming all baselines on the reported metrics while using 97% less training data than the largest one of them. Annotator effort declined from 54% of tokens to a plateau of 14-18%, an operational progress metric that requires no separate gold standard and can serve as a stopping criterion.
articles.comment: 40 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/gpizzorno/correction-as-annotation . Trained models archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22048602
articles.titleCn: 作为注释的修正：为纪录片中的中世纪拉丁语构建依存句法分析器
articles.abstractCn: 现有的自然语言处理工具在处理中世纪文献资料方面仍存在不足。五个现成的拉丁语树库模型在处理1258年至1446年间马赛编制的160份清单集合时均未达到可用性能水平。最佳标注依存评分仅为0.62，最佳形态感知评分仅为0.24。性能表现与文体或时期邻近性无关。为弥补这一缺陷，通过使用这些不足的工具产生了领域内训练数据。在九次迭代中，每个模型预先标注200个句子；专家修正标注；修正后的句子用于训练后续模型，批次独立于模型状态，无需主动学习选择。1804个句子的33小时标注工作将通用词性标注准确率从0.80提升至0.98，标注依存准确率从0.48提升至0.92，在所报告的指标上均优于所有基线模型，同时使用的训练数据量比其中规模最大的模型减少了97%。标注工作量从54%的词元降至14-18%的平台期，这一运营进度指标无需单独的黄金标准，可作为停止准则。

articles.title: Beyond the Flag: Clinical Framing Closes the Moderation Gap in Suicide Risk Measurement
articles.abstract: Moderation APIs are built to flag policy-violating content, not to measure graded clinical risk. But a platform's duty does not end at detection: the response owed to passive distress differs sharply from the response owed to active planning with means access, and emerging regulation (e.g., California Senate Bill 243) is turning that distinction into a compliance requirement. We therefore ask how well deployed safety signals recover clinically meaningful severity. We release a benchmark of 516 r/SuicideWatch posts rated by a licensed psychiatrist on a four-level ordinal schema (Indicator, Ideation, Behavior, Attempt) grounded in the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale, and evaluate moderation APIs, prompted LLMs, and supervised baselines under seven ordinal-aware metrics. Three findings. Vendor moderation APIs separate low- from high-severity posts well (0.860 high-risk F1) but measure severity poorly (0.395 macro F1), systematically over-predicting the most severe category. Clinically grounded zero-shot prompting recovers much of that gap (0.562 macro F1), and expert-authored framing (not fine-tuning, added reasoning, or naive multi-agent aggregation) is the effective lever. The value of reasoning depends on register: it hurts on long, noisy Reddit posts and helps on short, clinician-authored statements. We argue graded severity, not a binary flag, is what a proportionate duty of care requires, and release our evaluation framework to support that measurement.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 5th Workshop on NLP for Positive Impact (NLP4PI), EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: 超越旗帜：临床框架缩小了自杀风险测量的调节差距
articles.abstractCn: 审核API旨在标记违反政策的内容，而非衡量分级临床风险。但平台的义务并未止于检测：对被动痛苦的回应与对具备手段的主动计划的回应截然不同，新兴法规（例如加利福尼亚州参议院法案第243号）正将这一区分转化为合规要求。因此，我们探究部署的安全信号如何恢复具有临床意义的严重程度。我们发布了一个包含516篇r/SuicideWatch帖子的基准，这些帖子由持证精神科医生根据哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表的四级序数框架（指标、意念、行为、企图）进行评定，并在七个序数感知指标下评估了审核API、提示式大型语言模型和监督基线。三项发现。供应商审核API能很好地将低严重程度与高严重程度帖子区分开（高风险F1为0.860），但严重程度衡量不佳（宏观F1为0.395），系统性地高估了最严重类别。临床基础上的零样本提示能弥补大部分差距（宏观F1为0.562），而由专家撰写的框架（非微调、增加推理或天真多智能体聚合）是有效杠杆。推理的价值取决于语境：在长而嘈杂的Reddit帖子中它有害，而在短的临床医生撰写的声明中它有帮助。我们认为，分级严重程度而非二元标记是比例适度的护理义务所要求的，并发布了我们的评估框架以支持该测量。

articles.title: VDiff-Bench: A Challenging Benchmark for Fine-Grained Image Difference Identification
articles.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) perform strongly on general visual understanding tasks such as visual question answering, yet they often struggle with a basic comparative skill: identifying what has changed between two similar images. We introduce VDiff-Bench, a challenging multiple-choice benchmark for fine-grained Image Difference Identification. VDiff-Bench contains 1,756 four-way questions over image pairs and covers 10 change categories: position, motion, regional image color, overall image color, appearance/disappearance, noise/resolution, texture, substitution/size, OCR/text, and illumination. Each question corresponds to two image inputs with 4 choices: the true difference, two hard negative descriptions, and a "no difference" distractor. To make the task challenging, we specifically curate ground-truth-conditioned negatives that require models to distinguish the actual change from nearby semantic alternatives. Experiments with 11 state-of-the-art open- and closed-source MLLMs show that fine-grained visual comparison remains brittle: models exhibit uneven performance across sources and change categories, with persistent failures on subtle low-level changes like noises and textures. For instance, three 7-8B-scale open-source MLLMs score 52.5-70.6% on semantic changes but only 8.7-33.3% on low-level changes like noise and texture, falsely assuming no changes between two image inputs. Surprisingly, despite strong performance of other closed-source commercial models, Grok 4.3 demonstrate remarkable performance drop on identifying noise and texture differences between images, falling significantly behind large open-source models like Kimi K2.5 and K3. Overall, VDiff-Bench provides a targeted diagnostic for evaluating comparative visual understanding in MLLMs, exposing failures that are not captured by standard single-image vision-language tasks.
articles.titleCn: VDiff-Bench：一个用于细粒度图像差异识别的挑战性基准
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉问答等通用视觉理解任务上表现出色，但它们往往难以处理一项基本比较技能：识别两张相似图像之间的变化。我们引入VDiff-Bench，这是一个具有挑战性的多选题基准，用于细粒度图像差异识别。VDiff-Bench包含1,756个关于图像对的四向问题，涵盖10种变化类别：位置、运动、区域图像颜色、整体图像颜色、出现/消失、噪声/分辨率、纹理、替换/大小、OCR/文本和光照。每个问题对应两张图像输入和4个选项：真实差异、两个困难的负描述以及一个“无差异”的干扰项。为了使任务更具挑战性，我们特别策划了基于真实条件约束的负样本，要求模型从邻近的语义替代中区分实际变化。通过对11个最先进的开源和闭源MLLMs进行的实验表明，细粒度视觉比较仍然脆弱：模型在不同来源和变化类别上的表现不均衡，在噪声和纹理等细微低级变化上持续失败。例如，三款7-8B规模的开放源MLLMs在语义变化上的得分为52.5-70.6%，但在噪声和纹理等低级变化上的得分仅为8.7-33.3%，错误地假设两张图像输入之间没有变化。令人惊讶的是，尽管其他闭源商业模型表现出色，Grok 4.3在识别图像之间的噪声和纹理差异时表现显著下降，远远落后于Kimi K2.5和K3等大型开放源模型。总体而言，VDiff-Bench为评估MLLMs的比较视觉理解提供了针对性的诊断工具，揭示了标准单图像视觉语言任务未能捕捉到的失败之处。

articles.title: SLATE: Are AI-Generated Slides Educationally Effective? A Benchmark for Language Teaching Quality and Learner Knowledge Acquisition
articles.abstract: LLMs have achieved remarkable capabilities in generating language teaching slides. However, a critical mismatch persists between visual polish and actual instructional effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce SLATE (Slide-based Learning Assessment for Teaching Effectiveness), the first benchmark that evaluates AI-generated language teaching slides through instructional effectiveness and learner knowledge acquisition. SLATE transforms linguistics olympiad puzzles from low-resource languages with negligible web presence into 90 standardized instructional units comprising 1,133 assessable items, paired with a structured course outline and matched near- and far-transfer test sets. This pretest-posttest design eliminates pretrained knowledge leakage, ensuring gains reflect learning rather than prior recall. Using VLMs as scalable learner proxies and directionally supported by a three-system human pilot, our results show that content validity exhibits a weak association with learning gain, while pedagogical design exhibits a robust positive association. Moreover, most systems show a significant gap between near- and far-transfer accuracy, and even frontier models can produce negative learning gains. SLATE reveals a dissociation between artifact quality and instructional effectiveness, calling for a paradigm shift in how generative teaching systems are built, evaluated, and deployed.
articles.titleCn: SLATE：人工智能生成的幻灯片在教育上是否有效？语言教学质量与学习者知识获取的基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在生成语言教学幻灯片方面已取得显著能力，然而视觉完善与实际教学效果之间存在关键不匹配。为弥补这一差距，我们引入SLATE（基于幻灯片的教效评估），这是首个通过教学效果和学习者知识获取来评估人工智能生成语言教学幻灯片的基准。SLATE将语言学竞赛谜题从资源匮乏且网络几乎无足迹的低资源语言中转化为90个标准化的教学单元，包含1133个可评估项目，并配有结构化课程大纲及匹配的近迁移和远迁移测试集。这种前测-后测设计消除了预训练知识泄露，确保进步反映学习而非先前回忆。使用视觉语言模型作为可扩展的学习者代理，并在三系统人类试点方向性支持下，我们的结果显示内容效度与学习进步呈弱关联，而教学设计则表现出强正向关联。此外，大多数系统在近迁移和远迁移准确率之间显示出显著差距，即使是前沿模型也可能产生负向学习进步。SLATE揭示了人工制品质量与教学效果之间的分离，呼吁在生成教学系统的构建、评估和部署方式上实现范式转变。

articles.title: MLLMs Hallucinate when Information Distribution Drifts in Synergy Heads
articles.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with hallucinations, thus hindering their reliable practical applications. Existing attention-based mitigation methods mainly rely on indirect signals (e.g., attention weights) that fail to accurately reflect the actual information shift underlying hallucination generation. In this paper, we propose HEAL, Head-lEvel information disentAnglement and caLibration for identifying and mitigating hallucinations. HEAL first employs causal noise intervention on multi-head outputs to filter out causally redundant heads. Subsequently, it disentangles information distribution within the remaining heads via the counterfactual Difference-in-Differences, categorizing heads into four types. Through analysis, we observe: hallucinations happen when information distribution drifts away from a healthy equilibrium in synergy heads, not strongly correlated with the quantity or strength of modality-specific heads. Motivated by this insight, HEAL injects dynamic information calibration factors into the value vectors of synergy heads, and actively regulates visual-language dependencies, steering the output distribution towards factual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HEAL effectively reduces hallucinations across multiple MLLMs, offering a simple and interpretable pathway to enhance model trustworthiness.
articles.titleCn: 当信息分布漂移时，协同头中的MLLMs会产生幻觉。
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）常出现幻觉现象，这阻碍了它们在实际应用中的可靠性。现有的基于注意力机制的缓解方法主要依赖间接信号（例如注意力权重），这些信号无法准确反映幻觉生成背后的实际信息变化。在本文中，我们提出了HEAL（Head-level information disentanglement and calibration），一种用于识别和缓解幻觉的机制。HEAL首先对多头输出进行因果噪声干预，以过滤掉因果冗余的头部。随后，通过反事实双重差分法解耦剩余头部的信息分布，并将头部分为四类。通过分析，我们观察到：幻觉发生时，协同头部的信息分布会偏离健康平衡状态，与特定模态头部的数量或强度没有强相关性。基于这一发现，HEAL向协同头部的值向量注入动态信息校准因子，并主动调控视觉-语言依赖关系，引导输出分布向事实证据靠拢。大量实验表明，HEAL能有效减少多个MLLM的幻觉现象，为提升模型可信度提供了一种简单且可解释的途径。

articles.title: What the Window Does Not Contain: Auditing Provenance in a Document-Grounded Instability Benchmark
articles.abstract: Ask a language model the same question about the same document twenty times, and it sometimes returns two different answers. We built Probity, a benchmark of 60 tasks and 470 items from real venture-financing filings, to measure how often this happens. Then we audited our own corpus and found a defect any excerpt-built benchmark can carry: items whose evidence is missing from the window of text the model is shown. The audit flags 36 items and separates two failures a single flag would conflate: evidence genuinely absent from the window and answers that must be computed from numbers the window does supply. Flagged items change their answers far more often, wobbling at 0.255 against 0.087 on the 427 clean items, and excluding them cuts apparent cross-model agreement by about a fifth. Before testing whether the missing evidence explains the instability, we registered a prediction: re-cut each window to hold its evidence, and instability should fall below a set threshold. It failed: the repair moved wobble by 0.058, with an interval containing zero. We report the association as correlational. Almost all measurements sit where instability cannot show, which bounds what a corpus built for accuracy can say about stability. We release the corpus, all 112,800 raw responses, and the audit as a runnable check for any document benchmark.
articles.comment: Accepted as a poster at the 11th Workshop on Financial Technology and NLP (FinNLP 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/eikiyo/FoFinNLP
articles.titleCn: 窗口所不包含的内容：在一个基于文档的不稳定性基准中进行溯源审计
articles.abstractCn: 向语言模型就同一文档提出相同问题二十次，有时会得到两个不同的答案。我们构建了Probity，一个包含60项任务和470个真实风险投资申报材料的基准，来衡量这种情况发生的频率。然后我们审计了自己的语料库，发现任何基于摘录构建的基准都可能存在缺陷：模型展示的文本窗口中缺少证据的项目。审计标记了36个项目，并将两个本应被单个标记混淆的失败情况区分开来：证据确实缺失的窗口和必须根据窗口提供的数字计算答案的情况。被标记的项目答案变化频率更高，在427个干净项目上摇摆于0.255，而排除它们使模型间显式一致性降低了约五分之一。在测试缺失证据是否解释了不稳定性之前，我们提出了一个预测：重新裁剪每个窗口以包含其证据，不稳定性应低于设定阈值。这个预测失败了：修复措施使摇摆度增加了0.058，其区间包含零。我们报告这种关联性为相关性。几乎所有测量值都落在不稳定性无法显示的范围内，这界定了为准确度构建的语料库对稳定性的说明能力。我们发布了语料库，包括全部112,800个原始响应，以及审计，作为任何文档基准的可运行检查。

articles.title: Protocol Compression Changes Which Party Pays: Bilateral Cost in Cross-Organization LLM Agent Communication
articles.abstract: Agents that talk across organizations exchange long messages billed by the token. A shorter notation therefore looks like a saving that costs nothing but an agreement to use it. Recent work reports the saving is conditional. Compressed notation can instead raise total tokens by 8% to 11% over a JSON baseline, when parsing failures force extra model calls. That is measured for one payer. Between two organizations neither side can install a decoder at the other end, and each pays under its own tokenizer, price, and cache state. We measure both sides. A preregistered token-level study covered 198 content-matched item pairs across six vendors, for 2,376 native-usage cells. We then overlay an English baseline, runtime schema negotiation followed by compression, and injected-schema compression on a two-party procurement bargain with an exactly enumerated feasible set. The overlay covers 1,053 completed dialogues of a 1,215-cell grid across 3 model pairs, plus a 405-dialogue rerun of the negotiated condition. Compression amplifies cross-vendor cost dispersion by a factor of 1.078, with a 95% CI of [1.066, 1.091], and two vendor pairs reverse which endpoint is cheaper. Runtime negotiation succeeds as a protocol and fails as a bargain. The parties agree a schema in 121 of 135 headline dialogues, none of them the schema we would have supplied. They settle the task in only 9 of those dialogues, and they reach impasse in 106 of them. The negotiated sessions average 10.8 turns against 17.6, and cost 52% of the English total because sessions end sooner, not because the handshake is repaid. Break-even horizons run from 20 to 70 turns, the low end only under the conditional accounting, and all of them lie above every observed English session. On one cross-vendor pair both parties keep about half their cost. On the other the receiving party pays more at a high cache-hit rate.
articles.titleCn: 协议压缩改变了谁付费：跨组织LLM代理通信中的双边成本
articles.abstractCn: 跨组织通信的代理通过令牌计费交换长消息。因此，更短的表示法看起来是一种无需协议只需同意使用的节省。近期研究表明这种节省是有条件的。当解析失败导致额外模型调用时，压缩表示法反而会使总令牌数比JSON基线高出8%至11%。这是针对单个付款方的测量。在两个组织之间，任何一方都无法在对方端安装解码器，并且各自根据自己的分词器、价格和缓存状态支付。我们测量了双方。一项预先注册的按令牌级别研究涵盖了六个供应商之间198对内容匹配的项目，涉及2,376个原生使用单元。然后我们在一个具有明确枚举可行集的两方采购交易上叠加了英语基线、运行时模式协商后压缩以及注入模式压缩。叠加部分覆盖了3对模型在1,215个单元网格上的1,053个已完成对话，以及405个对话的协商条件重跑。压缩使跨供应商成本差异放大了1.078倍，95%置信区间为[1.066, 1.091]，并且有两对供应商逆转了哪个端点更便宜。运行时协商作为协议成功，但作为交易失败。双方在135个主要对话中的121个对话中达成了一致，但其中没有一个是我们会提供的模式。他们在其中9个对话中完成任务，并在106个对话中陷入僵局。协商会话的平均回合数为10.8，而英语为17.6，因为会话提前结束，而不是握手被偿还，因此成本为英语总成本的52%。盈亏平衡点在20至70回合之间，低端仅在条件性会计下，并且所有这些都高于每个观察到的英语会话。在其中一个跨供应商对中，双方各保留约一半成本。在另一个对中，在高缓存命中率下，接收方支付更多。

articles.title: STQA: A Benchmark for Stock-Focused Tabular Question Answering over Historical and Forecasted Data
articles.abstract: Stock market analysis inherently requires composite reasoning over historical records and future projections, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across isolated tasks. We introduce STQA (Stock-focused Tabular Question Answering), an end-to-end benchmark designed to systematically evaluate natural-language question answering over historical data, numerical forecasts, and forecast-based reasoning. Built on a large-scale financial dataset, STQA covers 4,417 stocks and contains 31,400 question-answer pairs derived from expert-crafted templates, accompanied by fine-grained intent and slot annotations. To operationalize this benchmark, we present SQFRS (Stock Query-Forecast-Reasoning System), an agent-based unified framework that orchestrates SQL retrieval and time-series forecasting tools. Experiments demonstrate that while current large language models perform well on historical queries, forecast-based reasoning poses a substantial challenge, revealing critical bottlenecks in tool coordination and reasoning under uncertainty. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/xuxubaobaoan/STQA_Project. STQA thus serves as a rigorous testbed for future research on trustworthy, tool-augmented financial agents.
articles.comment: 9 pages of main text, 15 pages of appendices, 19 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: STQA：一个用于历史和预测数据的股票聚焦型表格问答基准
articles.abstractCn: 股票市场分析本质上需要对历史记录和未来预测进行综合推理，但现有的基准仍然分散在孤立的任务中。我们介绍了STQA（股票聚焦型表格问答），这是一个端到端的基准，旨在系统地评估自然语言问题在历史数据、数值预测以及基于预测的推理上的问答能力。该基准基于大规模金融数据集构建，涵盖了4,417支股票，包含31,400个由专家设计模板生成的问题答案对，并配有细粒度的意图和槽位标注。为了使该基准得以运作，我们提出了SQFRS（股票查询-预测-推理系统），这是一个基于智能体的统一框架，协调SQL检索和时间序列预测工具。实验表明，尽管当前的大型语言模型在历史查询上表现良好，但基于预测的推理却构成了重大挑战，揭示了工具协调和不确定性推理中的关键瓶颈。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/xuxubaobaoan/STQA_Project获取。因此，STQA为未来关于可信、工具增强型金融智能体的研究提供了一个严格的测试平台。

articles.title: From Two Passes to One: Compact and Efficient Target-Stance Extraction
articles.abstract: Target-Stance Extraction (TSE) is the task of predicting both the target (or topic) of an author's writing and the author's stance toward it. Existing approaches to TSE use a sequential pipeline of two separate neural models: one to identify the target and another to determine the stance. We present a one-pass, joint architecture that predicts both in a single forward pass, reducing trainable parameters by nearly 50% with only a 4-7 F1 point tradeoff in performance. We further demonstrate that standard target-scrubbing practices artificially suppress target prediction accuracy. Retaining explicit target mentions, as in real-world deployments, improves F1 by at least 6 points across both target classification and target generation settings. These improvements allow for significantly easier integration of TSE in downstream applications such as public opinion tracking.
articles.titleCn: 从两遍到一遍：紧凑高效的靶立场提取
articles.abstractCn: 目标立场提取（TSE）的任务是预测作者写作的目标（或主题）以及作者对其的立场。现有的TSE方法使用一个由两个独立的神经模型组成的顺序流水线：一个用于识别目标，另一个用于确定立场。我们提出了一种单次、联合架构，在单个前向传递中预测两者，通过仅牺牲4-7个F1分数点，将可训练参数减少了近50%。我们进一步证明，标准的“目标清理”实践会人为地抑制目标预测的准确性。在现实世界的部署中保留明确的目标提及，在目标分类和目标生成两种设置下，F1分数均提高了至少6个点。这些改进使得TSE能够更轻松地集成到下游应用中，例如公众意见追踪。

articles.title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
articles.abstract: Data policies for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) determine which rollouts are used, how strongly they are weighted, and which domains contribute to subsequent training batches. We introduce DataFlex-RL, an evaluation platform for comparing these choices under a common GRPO recipe. Our primary experiment evaluates 13 configurations across 12 matched seeds using Qwen2.5-7B-Base and 12 mathematics, logic, and science benchmarks. Uniform GRPO improves the domain-balanced average accuracy by 7.76 percentage points over the untrained checkpoint. None of the eight rollout-selection or reweighting methods achieves a paired 95% confidence interval that excludes zero relative to uniform sampling, and none of the three adaptive mixtures outperforms a fixed equal mixture at the same level of precision. A corrected 12-seed extension on Llama-3.1-8B-Base places the additional methods on the same score scale as the original controls, but does not reveal a consistent winner in terms of observed mean performance. We also quantify evaluation sensitivity by rescoring nine Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct runs using a math-heavy six-benchmark summary, consisting of five mathematics benchmarks and GPQA-Diamond but no logic benchmark, and comparing it with the domain-balanced 12-benchmark summary. The resulting rankings are negatively correlated, with a correlation coefficient of -0.33, whereas summaries that retain all 12 benchmarks largely agree. Across the controlled settings studied here, changing the data policy measurably changes the training process but does not produce a reproducible improvement over uniform training.
articles.titleCn: DataFlex-RL：一个用于RLVR数据策略的评价平台
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的数据策略决定了哪些 rollout 被使用、它们的权重强度以及哪些领域为后续训练批次做出贡献。我们引入了 DataFlex-RL，一个用于在通用 GRPO 配方下比较这些选择的评估平台。我们的主要实验使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Base 和 12 个数学、逻辑和科学基准，在 12 个匹配种子上评估了 13 种配置。均匀 GRPO 将领域平衡平均准确率提高了 7.76 个百分点，超过未经训练的检查点。在 rollout 选择或重新加权方法中，没有一种方法在相对于均匀采样的配对 95% 置信区间内排除零相对提升，并且三种自适应混合方法在相同精度水平上均未超过固定等量混合。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Base 上的 12 种种子修正扩展中，将额外方法置于与原始对照相同的分数尺度上，但并未在观察到的平均性能方面揭示出一致的胜者。我们还通过使用一个以数学为主的六基准摘要重新评分九次 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 运行，该摘要由五个数学基准和 GPQA-Diamond 组成但不包含逻辑基准，并将其与领域平衡的 12 基准摘要进行比较，量化了评估敏感性。结果排名呈负相关，相关系数为 -0.33，而保留所有 12 个基准的摘要基本一致。在所研究的受控设置中，改变数据策略会显著改变训练过程，但并未产生超过均匀训练的可重复改进。

articles.title: VERPO: Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Verifiable outcome rewards guide language-model post-training, but sequence-level advantages do not identify which token-level decisions should be preserved or revised. Evidence-conditioned Teachers provide denser supervision by replaying sampled trajectories with privileged feedback. Yet indiscriminate imitation risks transferring formatting or reasoning-style shifts that do not support task success. We introduce VERPO, a Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization framework that treats evidence as a proposal for policy correction while retaining the outcome objective. It separates evidence-free reference restoration from signed token-level evidence corrections. Fisher Evidence Contrast attenuates corrections along an estimated evidence-presence direction. A stopped token-wise ZPD controller scales acceptance according to local reward alignment and Fisher movement cost, while the reference channel remains independent of acceptance. Across five scientific-reasoning and tool-use tasks, the best variant on each backbone exceeds the strongest compared baseline in average score. The averages rise from 0.6826 to 0.6857 on Qwen3-4B, from 0.6895 to 0.7058 on Qwen3-8B, and from 0.4751 to 0.5657 on Llama-3.2-1B.
articles.titleCn: VERPO：验证证据正则化策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 可验证结果奖励指导语言模型的后续训练，但序列级优势无法识别应保留或修改的哪些标记级决策。证据条件教师通过重放带有特权反馈的采样轨迹提供更密集的监督。然而，无差别模仿可能存在将不支持任务成功的格式或推理风格转移的风险。我们引入VERPO，这是一个验证证据正则化策略优化框架，它将证据视为策略修正的提议，同时保留结果目标。它将无证据参考恢复与带符号的标记级证据修正分开。Fisher证据对比沿着估计的证据存在方向减弱修正。停止的标记级ZPD控制器根据局部奖励对齐和Fisher运动成本来调整接受度，而参考通道保持独立于接受度。在五个科学推理和工具使用任务中，每个主干的最佳变体在平均分数上均超过了最强的对比基线。平均分数从Qwen3-4B的0.6826提高到0.6857，从Qwen3-8B的0.6895提高到0.7058，从Llama-3.2-1B的0.4751提高到0.5657。

articles.title: ACE: Adapter Consolidation across Experts for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of MoE LLMs
articles.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly attaches a separate low-rank adapter to each expert. This expert-wise design fragments adaptation in three ways: capacity is split across narrow low-rank updates, gradient supervision becomes sparse and imbalanced under sparse routing, and execution is decomposed into many small GEMMs. We find that such expert-wise separation is often unnecessary, as subsets of LoRA adapters become functionally similar during fine-tuning, revealing redundancy among expert-specific adapters. Based on this redundancy, we propose ACE (Adapter Consolidation across Experts), which groups redundant experts and replaces their expert-specific adapters with group-shared higher-rank LoRA modules under the same PEFT budget. ACE further introduces grouped adapter execution, which consolidates fragmented expert-wise adapter computations into fewer, larger group-level GEMMs. Across evaluations covering 12 datasets and four MoE backbones, ACE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the parameter-matched PEFT methods on the three backbones with complete baseline coverage, while providing $1.31\times$ to $1.48\times$ wall-clock training speedup over expert-wise LoRA without increasing peak memory. Our code is available at https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/ACE.
articles.titleCn: 专家间适配器整合以实现MoE大型语言模型的参数高效微调
articles.abstractCn: 参数高效的专家混合模型微调（PEFT）通常为每个专家附加一个单独的低秩适配器。这种专家级设计以三种方式将适配过程碎片化：容量被分割到狭窄的低秩更新中，梯度监督在稀疏路由下变得稀疏和不平衡，执行被分解成许多小的GEMM操作。我们发现这种专家级分离往往是多余的，因为在微调过程中，LoRA适配器的子集在功能上变得相似，揭示了专家特定适配器之间的冗余。基于这种冗余，我们提出了ACE（跨专家适配器整合），该方案将冗余专家分组，并在相同的PEFT预算下，用组共享的高秩LoRA模块替换它们的专家特定适配器。ACE进一步引入了分组适配器执行，将碎片化的专家级适配器计算整合到更少、更大的组级GEMM操作中。在涵盖12个数据集和四个MoE主干的评估中，ACE在三个完全覆盖基线的骨干网络上，在参数匹配的PEFT方法中实现了最高的平均准确率，同时在不增加峰值内存的情况下，比专家级LoRA提供了1.31倍到1.48倍的训练速度提升。我们的代码可在https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/ACE获取。

articles.title: DPH Parser: A Bottom-Up Grammar-Driven Parser for Joint Constituency and Dependency Analysis
articles.abstract: This paper presents Dependency-Phrase Hierarchy Parser (DPH Parser), a grammar-driven bottom-up unsupervized parsing framework inspired by Generalized Phrase Structure Grammar (GPSG) and Head-driven Phrase Structure Grammar (HPSG). The parser incrementally constructs constituency structures using a compact inventory of feature-based syntactic rules while deriving dependency relations through explicit head annotations. The system combines probabilistic POS tagging, recursive phrase projection, and weighted parse hypotheses to process realistic and partially noisy text input. Unlike purely neural and data-driven parsers, the resulting syntactic derivations remain explicitly interpretable. We evaluated parser performance on English corpora from the Universal Dependencies (UD) project using Unlabeled Attachment Score (UAS) as the main parsing metric, comparing the outcomes against Stanza and spaCy parsers. For a small inventory of syntactic rules, DPH parser achieved UAS values of 53.32% & 52.58% (UD Devset/Testset respectively). For the same data, Stanza achieved 89.12% & 88.67% while spaCy achieved 56.91% and 58.59%. Although the current system does not yet approach the accuracy of modern neural parsers, the results demonstrate the feasibility of applying transparent rule-based bottom-up parsing to realistic treebank data while jointly producing constituency and dependency structures.
articles.titleCn: DPH解析器：一种自底向上、基于文法的联合成分和依存分析解析器
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了一种名为依存短语层次解析器（DPH Parser）的语法驱动自底向上无监督解析框架，该框架受广义短语结构语法（GPSG）和头驱动短语结构语法（HPSG）的启发。该解析器使用紧凑的特征型句法规则库逐步构建成分结构，同时通过显式的头标注推导依存关系。该系统结合了概率词性标注、递归短语投射和加权解析假设来处理真实且部分含噪声的文本输入。与纯神经网络和数据驱动的解析器不同，所得句法推导结果仍然保持明确的可解释性。我们在通用依存（UD）项目提供的英语语料库上评估了该解析器的性能，以未标记依存评分（UAS）作为主要解析指标，并将结果与Stanza和spaCy解析器进行了比较。对于少量句法规则库，DPH解析器分别达到了53.32%（UD Devset）和52.58%（UD Testset）的UAS值。对于相同数据，Stanza达到了89.12%（Devset）和88.67%（Testset），而spaCy达到了56.91%和58.59%。尽管当前系统尚未达到现代神经网络解析器的准确度，但结果表明，透明规则驱动的自底向上解析在处理真实树库数据的同时联合生成成分结构和依存结构是可行的。

articles.title: Don't Lose Entities from Retrieval to Generation: Dual Entity Recovery RAG for multi-hop QA
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented multi-hop question answering (QA) decomposes a query into sub-questions and decomposes the corpus into smaller retrieval units such as sentences. Both forms of decomposition improve the pipeline, but we show that both share the same vulnerability, the loss of entity information, and that this loss breaks the pipeline at two separate points. The first point is retrieval, where a sub-question loses the entity resolved at the previous hop, leaving the retriever with nothing to match against. The second point is harder to see, because retrieval still appears to succeed. Once a passage is split into sentences, an isolated sentence loses the context that grounds its pronouns, so even with the correct sentence in hand the LLM cannot tell which entity the sentence is about. We isolate this second point as a distinct failure mode that we call lost-in-generation, and a retrieval-controlled experiment shows that it degrades answers even when the gold evidence is fixed in the context. We then propose Dual Entity Recovery RAG (DER-RAG), which keeps the grounding entity explicit from retrieval through to generation with two lightweight components, a two-way query decomposition that carries the resolved entity across sub-questions and a subject entity prefix attached to each sentence at generation time. DER-RAG needs no graph construction, no corpus modification, and no fine-tuning, yet on three multi-hop QA benchmarks it matches or exceeds strong baselines, including graph-based methods that depend on costly offline structures.
articles.comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: 不要从检索到生成中丢失实体：用于多跳问答的双实体恢复RAG
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强型多跳问答（QA）将查询分解为子问题，并将语料库分解为更小的检索单元，如句子。这两种形式的分解都改进了流程，但我们表明它们都存在相同的脆弱性，即实体信息的丢失，而这种丢失在两个不同的点上破坏了流程。第一个点是检索，此时子问题丢失了先前跳次解析的实体，导致检索器没有可供匹配的内容。第二个点更难察觉，因为检索似乎仍然成功。一旦段落被拆分为句子，孤立的句子会丢失其代词的指代语境，即使手头持有正确的句子，大型语言模型也无法判断句子所讨论的实体。我们将第二个点隔离为一个独特的失效模式，称之为“生成丢失”（lost-in-generation），并且检索控制的实验表明，即使黄金证据在上下文中固定，它也会降低答案质量。然后我们提出了双重实体恢复检索增强型问答（DER-RAG），它通过两个轻量级组件从检索一直保持到生成阶段，使锚定实体保持明确：一个双向查询分解机制，将解析的实体传递到子问题中，以及在每个生成时间附接到句子上的主实体前缀。DER-RAG无需图构建、语料库修改或微调，但在三个多跳QA基准测试中，它均达到了或超过了强大的基线方法，包括依赖昂贵离线结构的基于图的检索方法。

articles.title: GradeTrap: Authority Cues in Images Shift VLM Judgments Despite Explicit Instructions to Ignore Them
articles.abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) become increasingly capable and are deployed in consequential real-world settings, they must evaluate evidence independently rather than defer uncritically to human authority. We introduce GradeTrap, a controlled evaluation that places two social cues in direct conflict: a student answer, which should attract sycophantic agreement, and a conflicting answer attributed to a peer, teacher, or official answer key, which should attract authority-based deference. Models produce free-form answers while being explicitly instructed to solve independently and ignore all student answers, feedback, and grading marks. We test the models on 60 synthetic real-world trade-off scenarios. Five neutral trials establish a stable model-relative preference, followed by three repetitions of six experimental cues including controls. On the 45-item common intersection across Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-5.6 Luna, and Claude Haiku 4.5, a generic second-answer control yields 5.4% conflicting-answer selection. Relative to that control, pooled within-item changes show no reliable peer-review effect, a 6.9-point teacher-review effect, and a 19.5-point official-key effect. In contrast, a displayed conflicting student answer alone compared to a displayed student reference answer alone only raises selection from 2.2% to 5.2%. Official-key provenance therefore redirects judgements more than a student answer or the generic second-answer control, despite an explicit ignore instruction and an opposing student answer given along with the official key. Effects vary in magnitude across the three models.
articles.titleCn: GradeTrap：图像中的权威线索会改变视觉语言模型（VLM）的判断，尽管有明确指令要求忽略它们
articles.abstractCn: 随着视觉语言模型（VLMs）的能力日益增强并在重要的现实场景中得到部署，它们必须独立评估证据，而不是不加批判地顺从人类权威。我们引入了GradeTrap，这是一种受控评估，它将两个社会暗示置于直接冲突之中：一个学生答案，该答案应吸引奉承式的赞同，以及一个与之冲突的答案，该答案归因于同伴、教师或官方答案键，应吸引基于权威的顺从。模型在明确指示独立解决问题并忽略所有学生答案、反馈和评分标记的情况下生成自由形式的答案。我们在60个合成现实世界的权衡场景中测试了这些模型。五个中性试验建立了一个稳定的模型相对偏好，随后进行三次六种实验暗示（包括对照）的重复。在Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、GPT-5.6 Luna和Claude Haiku 4.5的45项共同交集上，一个通用的第二个答案对照产生了5.4%的冲突答案选择率。相对于该对照，项目内变化显示没有可靠的同行评审效应，有6.9分的教师评审效应，以及19.5分的官方答案键效应。相比之下，单独显示的冲突学生答案与单独显示的学生参考答案相比，仅将选择率从2.2%提高到5.2%。因此，官方答案键的来源比学生答案或通用第二个答案对照更能引导判断，尽管有明确的忽略指令，并且官方答案键与一个相反的学生答案一同给出。这些效应在三个模型中的幅度有所不同。

articles.title: Generating Adversarial Texts for Machine Translation via GRPO
articles.abstract: As machine translation (MT) systems continue to improve, standard benchmarks become less informative for exposing remaining weaknesses. Traditional methods for creating challenging test sets rely on expensive manual creation or curation, while automated approaches struggle to produce sets with the necessary translation difficulty and linguistic diversity. We propose a scalable reinforcement-learning-based approach for rewriting existing source texts into instances that are more difficult to translate for MT systems. We fine-tune a large language model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using reward signals based on translation difficulty together with constraints for semantic similarity, grammaticality, and approximate length preservation. On WMT25, our approach substantially reduces average COMET translation quality from 0.63 to 0.48, while preserving grammaticality and readability, whereas the base model remains at 0.64. Evaluations on the unseen WMT19-WMT24 benchmarks confirm that this behavior generalizes beyond the training data, and human evaluation further shows that the rewrites substantially lower translation quality while incurring a moderate drop in naturalness and only a small change in grammaticality. We release our code to support reproducibility.
articles.titleCn: 通过GRPO生成机器翻译对抗文本
articles.abstractCn: 随着机器翻译（MT）系统持续改进，标准基准测试在揭示剩余弱点方面变得不再那么具有信息量。传统创建具有挑战性的测试集的方法依赖于昂贵的人工创建或筛选，而自动化方法难以生成具有必要翻译难度和语言多样性的数据集。我们提出了一种基于强化学习的可扩展方法，用于将现有源文本改写成对MT系统更难翻译的实例。我们使用基于翻译难度的奖励信号以及语义相似性、语法正确性和近似长度保持的约束，对大型语言模型进行微调，采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）。在WMT25上，我们的方法将平均COMET翻译质量从0.63显著降低到0.48，同时保持了语法正确性和可读性，而基础模型仍保持在0.64。在未见的WMT19-WMT24基准测试上的评估证实，这种行为超出了训练数据，而人工评估进一步表明，改写显著降低了翻译质量，同时自然度仅略有下降，语法正确性仅发生微小变化。我们发布代码以支持可重复性。

articles.title: Factors Influencing the Emergence of Dependency Length Minimization in Neural Agent Simulations
articles.abstract: Given various grammatical options, language users prefer the word order choice that reduces the overall length of syntactic dependencies, a principle known as dependency length minimization (DLM). The origins of this preference remain an open question, particularly whether it originates from constraints on efficient information processing. Computational simulations provide a powerful approach to identifying the factors influencing the emergence of linguistic phenomena. However, previous simulations of DLM have not examined realistic interaction contexts and have produced mixed results. The present study investigates the emergence of DLM in artificial languages using a recently proposed language learning and communication framework based on recurrent neural networks (RNNs). In this framework, agents are trained to speak and interpret artificial languages and then use these languages to communicate. Using this framework, we study the impact of several factors related to processing limitations in a communicative setting, such as noise during listening, limited speaker capacity, and incremental sentence processing. Our results reveal a complex interplay among these factors in shaping word order preferences in neural agents. Specifically, in the full meaning space, agents regularize toward a single dominant word order, while in the half meaning space they show a short-before-long preference that only aligns with DLM in verb-initial languages. A consistent DLM preference emerges only when agents are subject to incremental processing pressure. These findings suggest that limitations in human cognitive processing may indeed play a role in shaping DLM. Our findings provide insights into the conditions under which neural models replicate human-like preferences and highlight the challenges of designing emergent communication models that capture human cognitive biases in language processing.

articles.titleCn: 影响神经代理模拟中依赖长度最小化出现因素
articles.abstractCn: 在多种语法选项中，语言使用者倾向于选择能减少句法依赖整体长度的词序，这一原则被称为依赖长度最小化（DLM）。这种偏好来源仍是一个悬而未决的问题，特别是它是否源于对高效信息处理的限制。计算模拟为识别影响语言现象产生的因素提供了强大途径。然而，以往的DLM模拟并未考察现实的交互环境，且结果不一。本研究通过基于循环神经网络（RNNs）的近期提出的语言学习和交流框架，在人工语言中探究DLM的产生。在该框架中，智能体被训练以说和解读人工语言，然后使用这些语言进行交流。利用该框架，我们研究了与交流环境中处理限制相关的多种因素的影响，例如听时噪声、说话者能力有限以及增量式句子处理。我们的结果表明，这些因素在塑造神经智能体的词序偏好中相互作用复杂。具体来说，在完整意义空间中，智能体会规范向单一主导词序发展，而在半意义空间中，它们表现出先短后长的偏好，这种偏好仅在动词起始语言中与DLM一致。只有当智能体受到增量式处理压力时，才会出现一致的DLM偏好。这些发现表明，人类认知处理的局限性确实可能在塑造DLM中发挥作用。我们的研究结果为神经模型在何种条件下复制类似人类的偏好提供了见解，并突出了设计能捕捉人类语言处理认知偏见的涌现交流模型所面临的挑战。

articles.title: Tri-PvP: Exposing Modality Bias in Omni-Modal Large Language Models through Perceptual-Propositional Evidence Conflicts
articles.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) jointly process vision, audio, and text, yet their modality bias under cross-modal conflict remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks conflate two distinct forms of evidence within a single modality: perceptual signals (e.g., a photograph or recording of a dog) and propositional signals (e.g., the declarative claim "this is a dog"), such that any measured modality bias is inherently confounded with evidence-form bias, precluding clean attribution to either source. To address this, we introduce Tri-PvP, an 8,000-sample tri-modal conflict benchmark crossing vision, audio, and text, where vision and audio each take perceptual or propositional form. Evaluating five OLLMs, we find robust visual bias across most models and evidence-type conditions. Crucially, we reveal a systematic asymmetry in evidence-form bias: models exhibit a stronger bias toward perceptual signal in vision but propositional in audio. Further analyses via layer-wise linear probing and contrastive decoding reveal that modality bias is already linearly decodable from early representation layers and can only be partially mitigated, calling for mitigation strategies beyond surface-level interventions.
articles.titleCn: Tri-PvP：通过感知-命题证据冲突揭示全模态大语言模型中的模态偏差
articles.abstractCn: 全模态大型语言模型（OLLMs）联合处理视觉、音频和文本信息，但其跨模态冲突下的模态偏差尚未得到充分探索。现有基准将单一模态内的两种不同证据形式混淆：感知信号（例如狗的照片或录音）和命题信号（例如断言“这是一只狗”），因此任何测量的模态偏差都不可避免地与证据形式偏差相互混淆，无法清晰地归因于任何来源。为解决这一问题，我们引入Tri-PvP，这是一个包含视觉、音频和文本的8000样本三模态冲突基准，其中视觉和音频分别以感知或命题形式呈现。通过评估五个OLLMs，我们发现大多数模型在大多数证据类型条件下都存在显著的视觉偏差。关键的是，我们揭示了一种系统性的证据形式偏差不对称性：模型在视觉中对感知信号存在更强的偏差，而在音频中对命题信号存在更强的偏差。通过逐层线性探测和对比解码的进一步分析表明，模态偏差已经可以从早期表征层线性解码，并且只能部分缓解，这表明需要超越表面干预的缓解策略。

articles.title: ModularPhaseNet: Finite-Cyclic Phase Geometry for Computable Semantic Hierarchy, Direction, and Context Consistency in Standard Transformers
articles.abstract: We propose ModularPhaseNet, a classical and integer-computable discretization of the continuous complex phase geometry introduced in QuantumPhaseNet. The real-valued hidden states of a standard Transformer are retained, while only an auxiliary phase channel is quantized into a cyclic subgroup G = <g> of order q | (p-1) in the multiplicative group of F_p. A continuous phase e^{i phi} is represented by z = g^a mod p; phase composition becomes group multiplication, relative phase becomes group division, conceptual hierarchy is induced by a filtration of cyclic quotients, semantic direction is represented by oriented relative group elements, and contextual consistency is measured by gauge-invariant cycle holonomy. The method introduces three components into an otherwise standard Transformer: a finite-phase encoder, a quotient-filtration hierarchy module, and a group-valued connection module. Their outputs enter self-attention as real-valued bias terms. Training uses distributions in the real group algebra or straight-through Gumbel-Softmax, whereas inference uses exact modular exponentiation and precomputed tables. No quantum hardware, complex-valued matrix multiplication, or discrete-logarithm computation is required. We prove quantization-distortion bounds, nesting of quotient-induced partitions, gauge invariance, a discrete integrability result for flat connections, and boundedness of the resulting attention output. The central empirical hypothesis is that these exact discrete invariants improve hierarchy recovery, discourse alignment, contradiction detection, and calibrated hallucination-risk prediction under a controlled compute budget. This paper reports the theory together with a pre-registered evaluation plan; the experiments described in Section 14 have not yet been carried out, and no empirical result is claimed here.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure. Extends arXiv:2602.14419 (WavePhaseNet) and arXiv:2608.15820 (QuantumPhaseNet). Theory and a pre-registered evaluation plan; no experimental results are reported
articles.titleCn: 模块化相位网络：标准Transformer中的可计算语义层级、方向和上下文一致性有限循环相位几何
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了ModularPhaseNet，这是一种经典的、整数可计算的离散化方法，用于量子相位网络（QuantumPhaseNet）中引入的连续复相位几何。标准Transformer的实值隐藏状态被保留，而仅将辅助相位通道量化为F_p乘法群中一个阶为q | (p-1)的循环子群G = <g>。连续相位e^{i phi}由z = g^a mod p表示；相位组合变为群乘法，相对相位变为群除法，概念层次通过循环商的滤化来诱导，语义方向由有向相对群元素表示，上下文一致性通过规范不变的循环荷隆度来衡量。该方法向标准Transformer引入了三个组件：有限相位编码器、商滤化层次模块和群值连接模块。它们的输出作为实值偏差项进入自注意力机制。训练使用实群代数中的分布或直通Gumbel-Softmax，而推理使用精确的模幂运算和预计算表。不需要量子硬件、复值矩阵乘法或离散对数计算。我们证明了量化失真界限、商诱导划分的嵌套性、规范不变性、平坦连接的离散可积性结果以及所得注意力输出的有界性。核心的实证假设是，这些精确的离散不变量在受控计算预算下能提高层次恢复、话语对齐、矛盾检测和校准的幻觉风险预测。本文报告了理论内容以及预先注册的评价计划；第14节中描述的实验尚未进行，此处不声称任何实证结果。

articles.title: Alignment by Stereotyping: How LLMs Sacrifice Individual Distinctiveness for Cultural Adaptation
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed for personalized interaction, and demographic conditioning via user profiles is a widely adopted strategy for cultural adaptation. We ask whether this approach genuinely serves individual users or achieves accuracy by erasing individual distinctiveness. Studying seven models including frontier GPT-5.1 on the World Values Survey, we find that demographic profiles improve value alignment accuracy for most models, but at a systematic cost to individuality. That is, models pull responses toward demographic group centroids rather than preserving individual differences, a behavioral pattern we term alignment by stereotyping. Permutation tests (10,000 permutations, six demographic attributes, seven models) certify that top-performing models compress individuals far above the human baseline; within-family scaling amplifies this tradeoff while degrading intrinsic cultural understanding. Using a synthetic dialogue dataset validated on real human-chatbot conversations from PRISM (Kirk et al., 2024), we further show that distributing demographic signals across conversational turns partially suppresses prototype retrieval compared to compact demographic labels, a finding validated on real conversations via PRISM but requiring replication at larger scale.
articles.titleCn: 刻板印象对齐：大语言模型如何为文化适应而牺牲个体独特性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于个性化交互，而通过用户资料进行人口统计调节是广泛采用的文化适应策略。我们探讨了这种方法是否真正服务于个体用户，或者通过抹除个体独特性来达到准确性。通过对包括前沿GPT-5.1在内的七个模型在世界价值观调查中的研究，我们发现人口统计资料提高了大多数模型的价值对齐准确性，但以牺牲个体性的系统成本为代价。也就是说，模型将回答拉向人口统计群体中心，而不是保留个体差异，我们称这种行为模式为刻板印象对齐。置换检验（10,000次置换，六个人口统计属性，七个模型）证实了表现最佳的模型在压缩个体方面远超人类基准；家庭内部缩放放大了这种权衡，同时降低了内在文化理解。使用在PRISM（Kirk等人，2024）中经过真实人机对话验证的合成对话数据集，我们进一步表明，将人口统计信号分布在对话回合中，与紧凑的人口统计标签相比，会部分抑制原型检索，这一发现通过PRISM在真实对话中得到验证，但需要在更大规模上重复验证。

articles.title: Beyond Cross-Lingual Transfer: Benchmarking Propagation Boundaries in Multilingual LLM Unlearning
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning aims to suppress target knowledge while preserving general capabilities. In multilingual settings, unlearning must additionally propagate within its intended linguistic scope. However, existing evaluations mainly measure cross-lingual transfer and cannot distinguish insufficient from excessive propagation. We introduce CLLPU (Cross-Lingual and Language-Bound Protocol for LLM Unlearning), a multilingual benchmark that formulates this problem through two settings: common-goal forgetting, where target knowledge should be suppressed across all languages, and language-conditioned forgetting, where suppression should remain confined to a designated language. CLLPU combines goal-guided topic pairing, schema-aware relation matching, and dual-anchor multilingual translation to construct 800 matched knowledge-unit pairs and 72,000 QA instances across ten languages. Experiments with six representative methods on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct reveal opposite failure modes: forgetting remains incomplete when universal suppression is required, yet spreads beyond the intended boundary when language-conditioned confinement is required. We further find that general multilingual utility can conceal damage to neighbor knowledge. These findings establish propagation control as a central challenge for multilingual LLM unlearning. We publicly release CLLPU together with its construction pipeline.
articles.titleCn: 超越跨语言迁移：多语言大语言模型去学习中的传播边界基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）去学习旨在抑制目标知识，同时保留通用能力。在多语言环境中，去学习还必须在预定的语言范围内传播。然而，现有的评估主要测量跨语言迁移，无法区分传播不足与过度传播。我们引入了CLLPU（跨语言和语言边界LLM去学习协议），一个多语言基准，通过两个设置来构建此问题：共同目标遗忘，其中目标知识应在所有语言中抑制，以及语言条件遗忘，其中抑制应局限于指定语言。CLLPU结合了目标引导的主题配对、模式感知的关系匹配和双锚多语言翻译，构建了800对匹配知识单元和72000个问答实例，覆盖十种语言。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的六种代表性方法实验揭示了相反的失效模式：当需要普遍抑制时，遗忘仍然不完整，而当需要语言条件限制时，传播超出了预定边界。我们进一步发现，通用多语言效用可能掩盖对邻近知识的损害。这些发现将传播控制确立为多语言LLM去学习的一个核心挑战。我们公开发布了CLLPU及其构建流程。

articles.title: The Blindness of Document-Level Translation Evaluation
articles.abstract: Document-level machine translation (MT) evaluation extends segment-level protocols by presenting full documents to annotators, on the assumption that such presentation elicits document-level judgments. We test this assumption with a counterfactual condition (MIX) in which each document combines segments drawn from different systems, preserving document-level presentation while breaking cross-segment consistency. Across 18,420 expert Englis-to-Korean annotations and 14 automatic metrics, scores, system rankings, and error annotations are statistically equivalent between coherent and incoherent documents. Perception does not explain this: shown matched passages, raters identify the coherent one as the work of a single translator in 87.3% of trials. Document presentation does change how annotators work, but that change does not reach the recorded output. What is blind is the protocol, not the annotator. The concern is not that scores fall short, but that the resources invested in document-level systems, metrics, and annotation may not be measuring what they are intended to measure.
articles.titleCn: 文档级翻译评估的盲目性
articles.abstractCn: 基于文档的机器翻译（MT）评估通过向标注者展示完整文档来扩展基于片段的协议，其假设是这种展示方式能够引出基于文档的判断。我们通过一个反事实条件（MIX）来检验这一假设，该条件中每个文档结合了来自不同系统的片段，从而在保持基于文档展示的同时破坏了跨片段的一致性。在18,420条专家英语至韩语标注和14个自动指标中，连贯文档和非连贯文档之间的得分、系统排名和错误标注在统计学上没有显著差异。感知并不能解释这一现象：当展示匹配的片段时，在87.3%的试验中，评阅者能够识别出连贯文档是单一译者的作品。文档展示确实改变了标注者的工作方式，但这种改变并未体现在记录的输出中。问题不在于得分不够理想，而在于投入到基于文档的系统、指标和标注中的资源可能并没有测量到它们本应测量的内容。

articles.title: SurveyAgent-HKA: A multi-agent framework for scientific survey generation with LLMs and human knowledge augmentation
articles.abstract: Automatic scientific survey generation has become an important task in scientific document processing. The common approach of retrieving literature from a single source (e.g., arXiv) and generating surveys through a one-pass large language model (LLM) call often leads to limited reference coverage and, more importantly, fails to replicate the expert-driven revision process that is crucial for writing high-quality surveys. In this paper, we introduce SurveyAgent-HKA, a multi-agent framework that improves end-to-end scientific survey generation by incorporating knowledge derived from published surveys and peer-review comments. The framework decomposes survey generation into well-defined sub-tasks handled by LLM-powered agent. It first retrieves relevant papers from multiple sources and identifies key topics through clustering to construct an initial outline, which is then refined using outlines from related human-written surveys. Based on the refined outline, topic-focused papers are retrieved and re-ranked to select for drafting a well-grounded survey. Then, we identify common issues raised by experts in peer-review comments from published surveys to guide the revisions and finalize the survey. Experiments on two domains show that our approach outperforms mainstream baselines in citation quality, structural consistency, and content quality. Furthermore, our framework is efficient in both time and cost, making it a practical solution for broader AI-assisted scientific writing applications.
articles.titleCn: SurveyAgent-HKA：一种基于LLMs和人类知识增强的科学调查生成多智能体框架
articles.abstractCn: 自动科学综述生成已成为科学文献处理领域的一项重要任务。从单一来源（例如arXiv）检索文献并通过单次调用大型语言模型（LLM）生成综述的常用方法往往导致参考文献覆盖范围有限，更重要的是，无法复制专家驱动的修订过程，而这一过程对于撰写高质量综述至关重要。在本文中，我们介绍了SurveyAgent-HKA，一个多智能体框架，通过整合已发表综述和同行评审评论中的知识来改进端到端科学综述生成。该框架将综述生成分解为由LLM驱动智能体处理的明确定义的子任务。它首先从多个来源检索相关论文，并通过聚类识别关键主题来构建初始大纲，然后利用相关人工撰写综述的大纲进行细化。基于细化后的大纲，检索并重新排序主题相关论文，以选择撰写基础扎实的综述。接着，我们从已发表综述的同行评审评论中识别专家提出的问题，以指导修订并最终确定综述。在两个领域的实验表明，我们的方法在引用质量、结构一致性和内容质量方面优于主流基线。此外，我们的框架在时间和成本效率方面都很高，使其成为更广泛AI辅助科学写作应用的实用解决方案。

articles.title: Solving versus Verifying: Catching Contradictions in Tax Reasoning Systems
articles.abstract: Large language models now compute correct tax liabilities on over 90% of well-formed cases in statutory benchmarks, which makes them candidates for the tax-advisory and compliance systems that consume such an answer directly. Real legal inputs, however, are frequently defective: required facts are missing, or stated facts contradict one another. Accuracy on clean benchmarks says nothing about how a model behaves then, and a system that computes straight through a defective input returns a confident number with no sign that anything is wrong. This raises two questions: does a model asked to solve a case abstain when the input is defective, and when it does not, can the same model catch the defect when asked instead to verify the input? We study six recent models on SARA-derived tax cases under missing-fact and contradictory-fact perturbations. The strongest models abstain when a fact is missing but compute through injected contradictions, returning the clean-input answer 63-76% of the time with no signal of the conflict; asked instead to verify the same input, they flag most of those contradictions. We wire that verification call into a simple contradiction gate: one extra call that abstains when the model reports a conflict. Across all six models it recovers most of the missed contradiction abstention at a clean-accuracy cost of at most about 5 percentage points, with no training and no external tooling. High accuracy on well-formed inputs is therefore an incomplete measure of reliability, and the detection the solver misses is cheaply recoverable with a single self-check.

articles.titleCn: 求解与验证：捕捉税务推理系统中的矛盾
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型现在能在法定基准测试中超过90%的规范案例中正确计算税务责任，这使得它们成为直接消费此类答案的税务咨询和合规系统的候选者。然而，真实法律输入经常存在缺陷：必要事实缺失，或陈述的事实相互矛盾。在干净基准测试上的准确性与模型在缺陷输入下的表现毫无关联，而一个直接计算缺陷输入的系统会返回一个自信的数字，没有任何错误迹象。这引出了两个问题：当输入有缺陷时，被要求解决案例的模型是否会回避，以及当它不回避时，能否在要求验证输入时检测到缺陷？我们研究了六种近期在SARA衍生税务案例中，针对缺失事实和矛盾事实扰动下的模型。最强的模型在事实缺失时会回避，但在注入矛盾时继续计算，63-76%的时间里返回干净输入的答案，没有任何冲突信号；当被要求验证相同输入时，它们会标记大部分矛盾。我们将验证调用连接到一个简单的矛盾门：当模型报告冲突时，这个额外调用会回避。在所有六种模型中，它以最多约5个百分点的干净准确率成本，恢复了大部分被忽略的矛盾回避，无需训练和外部工具。因此，在规范输入上的高准确率并不能完全衡量可靠性，而求解器遗漏的检测是可以通过单一自我检查廉价恢复的。

articles.title: Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning: Unlocking Efficient Alignment Mechanisms for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning paradigms, particularly Full Parameter Fine-Tuning are often plagued by parameter redundancy, inconsistent data quality, and catastrophic forgetting, which current methods typically address in isolation and lack a unified optimization signal to bridge data selection, parameter updates, and knowledge preservation. To address this, we propose Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning (NGFT), a holistic framework that leverages neuron activation patterns as a universal proxy to unify the fine-tuning lifecycle. NGFT operates via three synergistic mechanisms: (1) Adaptive Task-Specific Neuron Selection, which identifies essential neurons in a single forward pass to concentrate updates and reduce redundancy; (2) Activation-Based Data Selection, which prioritizes information-dense samples that maximize contribution to key neurons; and (3) Neuron Activation Alignment, a novel loss function that anchors activations to pre-trained states, deepening representation learning and preserving general knowledge. Experimental results across three models across both domain-specific and general benchmarks demonstrate that NGFT significantly outperforms existing mainstream fine-tuning methods in both efficiency and performance, while effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

articles.titleCn: 神经元引导微调：解锁大型语言模型的高效对齐机制
articles.abstractCn: 现有的监督微调范式，特别是全参数微调，常受参数冗余、数据质量不一致和灾难性遗忘等问题困扰，而当前方法通常孤立地解决这些问题，缺乏统一优化信号来衔接数据选择、参数更新和知识保留。为此，我们提出了神经元引导微调（NGFT）这一整体框架，利用神经元激活模式作为通用代理，统一微调生命周期。NGFT通过三种协同机制运作：（1）自适应任务特定神经元选择，通过单次前向传递识别关键神经元，集中更新并减少冗余；（2）基于激活的数据选择，优先选择信息密度高的样本，最大化对关键神经元的贡献；（3）神经元激活对齐，这是一种新型损失函数，将激活锚定到预训练状态，深化表征学习并保留通用知识。在三个模型上进行的跨领域特定和通用基准的实验结果表明，NGFT在效率和性能上均显著优于现有主流微调方法，同时有效缓解了灾难性遗忘问题。

articles.title: Structurally Close, Temporally Distant: Measuring Security Exposure in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with untrusted content, persistent memory, external state, and sensitive tools. Existing analyses often characterize attacks by the number of execution steps between malicious input and a downstream action. We show that temporal remoteness can overstate security separation in stateful agents. We introduce a provenance-aware execution graph linking agent events through deterministic state, identifier, and tool provenance, and define \emph{influence distance} $\DI$ as the shortest structural path from an untrusted source to a sensitive action. We compare it with \emph{sequence distance} $\DT$, the shortest injection--sink path in the ordered trajectory. Since the influence graph contains every sequence edge, $\DI \leq \DT$; $\Gap=\DT-\DI$ measures the separation hidden by step count. Across 454 injection--sink pairs from 360 long-horizon AgentDojo trajectories over OpenAI's \texttt{gpt-4o-mini} and \texttt{gpt-4o} and Claude's Haiku 4.5 and Sonnet 4.6, $\Gap>0$ for 96.9% of pairs, with a median gap of 9 hops; 91.0% remain decoupled after removing the largest provenance-only edge class. On AgentDojo's banking suite, 33.8% of 231 pairs from 377 trajectories decouple through different provenance mechanisms. Among 274 OpenAI pairs, $\Gap$ does not independently predict attack success after controlling for $\DT$, attack family, and backend ($β_{\Gap}=0.066$, $p=.088$). At matched thresholds $k=2,3$, a deterministic $\DI$-based pre-execution gate blocks five attack sinks missed by a sequence-only gate with no additional benign blocking, although the paired gain is not significant ($p=.0625$). Execution structure therefore reveals proximity hidden by step count and can support targeted runtime intervention. We measure candidate influence pathways rather than causal attribution.
articles.titleCn: 结构相似，时间相远：衡量长时程大语言模型代理中的安全暴露
articles.abstractCn: 长时程大语言模型代理会与不可信内容、持久化内存、外部状态和敏感工具交互。现有分析通常通过恶意输入和下游动作之间的执行步骤数量来描述攻击。我们证明，时间上的遥远性可能会高估状态化代理中的安全隔离。我们引入了一个来源感知执行图，通过确定性状态、标识符和工具来源将代理事件连接起来，并将\emph{影响距离} $\DI$ 定义为从不可信来源到敏感动作的最短结构路径。我们将其与\emph{序列距离} $\DT$进行比较，后者是有序轨迹中最短的注入-汇点路径。由于影响图包含每条序列边，$\DI \leq \DT$；$\Gap=\DT-\DI$ 衡量了被步骤计数隐藏的隔离程度。在来自360个长时程AgentDojo轨迹、涉及OpenAI的\texttt{gpt-4o-mini}和\texttt{gpt-4o}以及Claude的Haiku 4.5和Sonnet 4.6的454对注入-汇点中，96.9%的对$\Gap>0$，中位差距为9跳；在移除最大的仅来源边类后，91.0%的对仍然解耦。在AgentDojo的银行套件中，377个轨迹中的231对（33.8%）通过不同的来源机制解耦。在274对OpenAI中，$\Gap$在控制了$\DT$、攻击家族和后端后并不能独立预测攻击成功（$β_{\Gap}=0.066$，$p=.088$）。在匹配阈值$k=2,3$下，基于确定性$\DI$的执行前门禁可以阻止序列门禁遗漏的五个攻击汇点，且没有额外的良性阻断，尽管配对增益并不显著（$p=.0625$）。因此，执行结构揭示了被步骤计数隐藏的邻近性，并可以支持针对性的运行时干预。我们测量的是候选影响路径，而非因果归因。

articles.title: UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) excels on tasks with verifiable rewards, but in open-ended tasks, the reliability of reward models remains a key challenge. Existing solutions either depend on costly proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge systems or opaque scalar reward models that lack interpretability. Recent works on generative reward models offer a promising alternative, but they remain constrained by static evaluation criteria, fragmented evaluation paradigms, and limited multilingual support. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{MixReward}, a large-scale multilingual dataset spanning six domains and 103 languages, containing both pairwise and listwise data, and propose \textbf{UniRRM}, a unified reasoning reward model supporting multiple languages and evaluation paradigms. UniRRM uses a staged reasoning chain to dynamically generate task-generic and instruction-specific criteria, enabling fine-grained, input-adaptive judgments while maintaining consistency across languages. Experiments demonstrate that UniRRM-8B and UniRRM-14B achieve performance close to the state-of-the-art for models of comparable size across multiple benchmarks, and are effective for unseen evaluation paradigms. In addition, ablation studies validate the reliability and effectiveness of UniRRM.
articles.titleCn: 跨语言和评估范式统一推理奖励模型：UniRRM
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）在具有可验证奖励的任务上表现出色，但在开放性任务中，奖励模型的可靠性仍然是一个关键挑战。现有解决方案要么依赖于昂贵的专有LLM作为评判系统，要么依赖于缺乏可解释性的标量奖励模型。近期关于生成式奖励模型的研究提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但它们仍然受限于静态评估标准、碎片化的评估范式以及有限的多语言支持。为解决这些挑战，我们引入了\textbf{MixReward}，这是一个涵盖六个领域和103种语言的大规模多语言数据集，包含成对和列表数据，并提出了\textbf{UniRRM}，一个支持多种语言和评估范式的统一推理奖励模型。UniRRM使用分阶段的推理链动态生成任务通用和指令特定的标准，实现细粒度、输入自适应的判断，同时保持跨语言的连贯性。实验表明，UniRRM-8B和UniRRM-14B在多个基准测试中达到了与同等规模的模型接近的最先进性能，并且对未知的评估范式同样有效。此外，消融研究验证了UniRRM的可靠性和有效性。

articles.title: From Narrative to Auditable Forecasts: A Structured Scaffold for Agentic Forecasting
articles.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for live forecasting, where they retrieve up-to-date information and produce estimates for unresolved future events. However, current agentic forecasting often relies on implicit narrative aggregation: agents collect evidence, discuss it in prose, and often assign a probability without an explicit update path from evidence to forecast. This limits both forecasting accuracy and auditability. We propose AuditForecast, an agentic scaffold for structured probabilistic forecasting. AuditForecast first anchors the forecast with a suitable quantitative baseline model, uses model-guided data retrieval to derive a base probability, and then applies situational factor updates outside the model's scope through mechanical aggregation in odds space. This turns forecasting from a prose-based judgment into a structured process with explicit intermediate objects. Across multiple live forecasting benchmarks, AuditForecast improves forecasting accuracy and calibration relative to strong agentic baselines, surpasses market-implied references in several settings, and outperforms substantially more expensive deep-research agents while remaining Pareto-dominant in the cost--accuracy tradeoff. Beyond performance gains, AuditForecast produces an auditable forecasting report that makes forecast construction explicit and supports systematic post hoc analysis.
articles.titleCn: 从叙事到可审计预测：自主预测的结构化框架
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地用于实时预测，它们检索最新信息并为未解决的未来事件生成估计。然而，当前的代理式预测往往依赖于隐式的叙事聚合：代理收集证据，用散文形式讨论，并经常在没有明确的证据到预测更新路径的情况下分配概率。这限制了预测的准确性和可审计性。我们提出了AuditForecast，一种用于结构化概率预测的代理式框架。AuditForecast首先用合适的定量基线模型锚定预测，使用模型引导的数据检索推导出基础概率，然后通过在赔率空间中进行机械聚合，在模型范围之外应用情境因素更新。这使得预测从基于散文的判断转变为具有明确中间对象的流程化过程。在多个实时预测基准测试中，AuditForecast相对于强大的代理式基线提高了预测准确性和校准度，在几种情况下超越了市场隐含参考，并在成本-准确度权衡中保持帕累托优势的同时，显著优于更昂贵的深度研究代理。除了性能提升之外，AuditForecast生成了一份可审计的预测报告，使预测构建过程明确化，并支持系统性的事后分析。

articles.title: AlignDiff: Exploiting Model-Intrinsic Information for Better Preference Data Selection
articles.abstract: Aligning large language models with human preferences remains a challenge, primarily due to the critical role of preference data quality in effective alignment. Existing datasets are frequently plagued by inherent noise and distribution shifts, which inherently limit model performance. To bridge this gap, we propose AlignDiff, a preference data filtering framework driven by intrinsic model signals. AlignDiff first identifies samples with clear preferences using both positive and inverse signals, then prioritizes the more challenging samples based on the average negative log-likelihood gap, encouraging the model to learn richer information from them. AlignDiff is evaluated on two widely used model families (LLaMA and Qwen) and three benchmarks widely adopted in the alignment community (AlpacaEval 2.0, Arena-Hard, and MT-Bench). Across all settings, it consistently outperforms seven strong baselines. We conduct comprehensive ablation studies to validate the effectiveness of AlignDiff, and further show that difficulty-based curriculum learning improves model performance.
articles.titleCn: AlignDiff：利用模型内禀信息以提升偏好数据选择
articles.abstractCn: 将大型语言模型与人类偏好进行对齐仍然是一个挑战，主要原因是偏好数据质量在有效对齐中起着至关重要的作用。现有的数据集经常受到固有噪声和分布偏移的困扰，这从根本上限制了模型性能。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了AlignDiff，一个由内在模型信号驱动的偏好数据过滤框架。AlignDiff首先使用正向和反向信号识别具有明确偏好的样本，然后根据平均负对数似然差距对更具挑战性的样本进行优先处理，鼓励模型从这些样本中学习更丰富的信息。AlignDiff在两个广泛使用的模型系列（LLaMA和Qwen）和三个在对齐社区广泛采用的基准（AlpacaEval 2.0、Arena-Hard和MT-Bench）上进行了评估。在所有设置中，它始终优于七个强大的基线。我们进行了全面的消融研究，以验证AlignDiff的有效性，并进一步表明，基于难度的课程学习可以提高模型性能。

articles.title: What if LLMs Ate Their Words: Causal History Effects in Multi-Turn Interaction
articles.abstract: Multi-turn interaction creates a feedback process in which an LLM's previous responses become context for later behavior. Prior work shows substantial multi-turn degradation and that assistant-generated history can affect later behavior. However, it remains unclear how these effects manifest across models, tasks, turns, and inside a model. We study these gaps across six task families and five models. Degradation from fully specified single-turn input (FULL) to progressively revealed multi-turn interaction (SHARDED) is clearly task- and model-dependent, and stronger one-shot performance does not imply greater interaction robustness. We then retrospectively analyze completed SHARDED conversations by replaying the user messages already observed in each trajectory while editing only assistant-generated history. Replacing prior assistant responses with neutral content (termed neutralization) changes downstream min-max normalized performance by +.027 across 2,973 trajectories. On a prespecified length-controlled subset, short and length-matched neutralization yield nearly identical effects (+.069 versus +.068), showing that simple context shortening is insufficient to explain the effect of history editing. Turn Surgery further intervenes on one assistant turn at a time. Among 237 selected degraded trajectories, 63.7% contain at least one beneficial intervention, while most tested positions remain unchanged; for binary tasks, 48.4% admit a fail-to-success reversal. An open-weight case study links behaviorally consequential history changes to measurable downstream state differences, but finds task-dependent rather than universal internal signatures. Overall, assistant-generated history has active but selective effects on multi-turn performance, motivating selective rather than uniform history management.

articles.titleCn: 如果大型语言模型说错了话：多轮交互中的因果历史效应
articles.abstractCn: 多轮交互在大型语言模型（LLM）中构建了一个反馈过程，其中模型先前生成的响应成为后续行为的上下文。已有研究表明多轮交互存在显著性能退化，且助手生成的历史记录会影响后续行为。然而，这些效应在不同模型、任务、轮次以及模型内部的表现尚不明确。我们通过六个任务家族和五个模型研究了这些空白。从完全指定的单轮输入（FULL）到逐步揭示的多轮交互（SHARDED）的性能退化明显依赖于任务和模型，且单次性能更强并不一定意味着交互鲁棒性更高。随后，我们通过重放每个轨迹中已观察到的用户消息，同时仅编辑助手生成的历史记录，对完成的SHARDED对话进行回顾性分析。用中性内容替换先前的助手响应（称为中性化）会改变下游归一化的最小-最大性能，在2,973个轨迹中提升了+0.027。在一个预设长度控制的子集上，短且长度匹配的中性化效果几乎相同（+0.069与+0.068），表明简单的上下文缩短不足以解释历史编辑的效果。轮次手术进一步逐轮干预。在237个选定的退化轨迹中，63.7%包含至少一次有益干预，而大多数测试位置保持不变；对于二元任务，48.4%实现了失败到成功的逆转。一个开放权重案例研究将行为相关的历史变化与可测量的下游状态差异联系起来，但发现的是任务依赖而非普遍的内部特征。总体而言，助手生成的历史记录对多轮性能具有主动但选择性的影响，这促使我们更倾向于选择性地而非统一地管理历史记录。

articles.title: SinoGlyphBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Chinese Glyph-Level Obfuscation in Language-Model Moderation
articles.abstract: Glyph-level obfuscation can leave harmful Chinese content readable to humans while degrading automated moderation. We introduce SinoGlyphBench, a diagnostic benchmark that identifies label-critical semantic anchors and creates matched original and glyph-obfuscated inputs in text and image modalities. By perturbing anchors, background context, or both, this design distinguishes corruption of moderation-relevant evidence from general surface variation. Across 176,916 paired evaluations of 12 LLMs and MLLMs, obfuscation increases harmful false-negative and false-positive rates by 6.1 and 4.7 percentage points, respectively, and reduces four-way accuracy by 5.0 points. Models retain 75.7% of the decisions that were correct on the matched original inputs. Full-scope perturbations cause the largest degradation, anchor-only perturbations are more damaging than background-only perturbations, and cross-script substitution is particularly difficult in the text modality. Analysis of structured outputs identifies observable mismatches in visible-form reading, intended-message recovery, and final safety judgment. The evaluated models, therefore, remain brittle to Chinese content written with non-canonical glyphs. Resources are available at https://github.com/fengshun124/SinoGlyphBench.
articles.titleCn: SinoGlyphBench：语言模型内容审核中汉字级混淆的诊断基准
articles.abstractCn: 字形级混淆可能使有害中文内容对人类可读，同时降低自动化审核效果。我们引入SinoGlyphBench，这是一个诊断基准，用于识别标签关键的语义锚点，并在文本和图像模态中创建匹配的原始和字形混淆输入。通过扰动锚点、背景上下文或两者，该设计区分了审核相关证据的破坏与一般表面变化。在12个LLM和MMLLM的176,916对评估中，混淆使有害的假阴性率和假阳性率分别增加了6.1和4.7个百分点，并将四向准确率降低了5.0点。模型保留了在匹配原始输入上正确决策的75.7%。全范围扰动导致最大程度退化，仅锚点扰动比仅背景扰动更具破坏性，跨文字替换在文本模态中尤其困难。结构化输出分析识别出在可见形式阅读、意图信息恢复和最终安全判断中的可观察不匹配。因此，被评估的模型对使用非规范字形的中文内容仍然脆弱。资源可在https://github.com/fengshun124/SinoGlyphBench获取。

articles.title: CONDUIT: A Unified Residual-Stream Restoration Framework for KV Cache Reuse in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often answer new questions about recurring visual content, where reusing the key-value (KV) cache can avoid re-encoding expensive visual prefixes. Exact-prefix reuse, however, fails when the same visual content appears under a changed prefix. Selective recomputation can recover quality under a small visual-token budget, but only when the right stale tokens are refreshed. Raw-attention selection can waste budget on high-attention tokens with small value-norm proxy scores and on query-irrelevant images. To address these failure modes, we propose CONDUIT, a training-free refresh policy that unifies single- and multi-image reuse as residual-stream restoration. Building on norm-weighted attention, CONDUIT ranks cached visual tokens using cached-key query attention and an accessible pre-output cached-value-norm proxy, then applies empirical image-level relevance amplification before one global selection. With one image, the coefficient is one and the rule reduces to intra-image token selection. The method preserves model architecture and weights, adding only a single query-conditioned scoring pass at inference. At a 10% refresh budget, CONDUIT achieves 97.0-99.5% of the corresponding full-prefill five-dataset average across three VLM backbones and leads budgeted methods on average; on the MMLongBench-Doc latency subset, it uses 13.5% of full-prefill FLOPs and achieves a 2.99x time-to-first-token speedup.

articles.titleCn: 管道：用于视觉-语言模型中KV缓存重用的统一残差流恢复框架
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）通常针对重复出现的视觉内容回答新问题，其中重用键值（KV）缓存可以避免重新编码昂贵的视觉前缀。然而，当相同视觉内容在改变的前缀下出现时，精确前缀重用会失效。选择性重新计算可以在较小的视觉标记预算下恢复质量，但这只有在正确刷新过时的标记时才有效。原始注意力选择可能会浪费预算在高注意力标记上，这些标记的值范数代理分数很小，并且与查询无关的图像也会被浪费。为了解决这些失效模式，我们提出了CONDUIT，这是一种无需训练的刷新策略，它将单图像和多图像重用统一为残差流恢复。基于范数加权注意力，CONDUIT使用缓存的键查询注意力和可访问的预输出缓存值范数代理对缓存的视觉标记进行排序，然后在全局选择之前应用经验图像级相关性放大。对于一张图像，系数为1，规则简化为图像内标记选择。该方法保留了模型架构和权重，仅在推理时添加了一个查询条件评分过程。在10%的刷新预算下，CONDUIT在三个VLM主干网络和五个数据集的平均值上达到了97.0-99.5%，平均优于预算方法；在MMLongBench-Doc延迟子集上，它使用了13.5%的完整填充FLOPs，并实现了2.99倍的首次标记加速。

articles.title: AtomCite: Verification and Correction of Supplied Page-Level Citations in Multi-Page Documents
articles.abstract: Large language models answering questions over multi-page documents are expected to cite the supporting pages, yet supplied citations are sometimes inaccurate, and current evaluations score citations at generation time or against text passages: no existing benchmark evaluates whether a system can verify and correct a page-level citation already attached to an answer. We propose AtomCite, an agentic framework that parses an answer into claims, checks each claim against the image of its cited page, and applies a deterministic repair policy. To evaluate it, we introduce DocCite, to our knowledge the first benchmark for systems that verify and correct page-level citations in document images. Built on MP-DocVQA and DUDE, it combines 928 validated injected instances with 2,468 candidate natural errors harvested from frontier- and efficiency-tier models, of which a two-annotator audit confirms 1,909 as genuine errors. Primary labels are assigned deterministically, not by LLM judges, with the human audit as a separate validation layer. Across three model families (Gemini, Claude, and GPT), AtomCite reaches around 93% binary verification accuracy on the injected benchmark, significantly outperforming every OCR-only condition, including a compute-matched control, and exceeding every prior text-based baseline given the same OCR text. Its repair policy lifts citation precision on the injected mix from a constructed 34% to 87-90% while retaining over 90% of correct claims. AtomCite also transfers: with frozen prompts and zero training, it raises the hallucination-detection scores of two open 7-8B models on five public benchmarks above the same models prompted as direct judges. Finally, the audit shows that noise in automatic labels biases measured verifier accuracy and can reverse system rankings, so evaluations relying only on synthetic or automatic labels risk mismeasuring verification capability.
articles.titleCn: AtomCite：多页文档中提供的页级引文的验证与纠正
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在处理多页文档回答问题时，被期望引用支持性页码，但提供的引用有时不准确，而当前评估方法是在生成时或针对文本段落对引用进行评分：目前没有基准评估系统能否验证并纠正已经附加到答案中的页级引用。我们提出了AtomCite，一个代理框架，将答案解析为论点，检查每个论点与其引用页面的图像是否一致，并应用确定性修复策略。为了评估它，我们引入了DocCite，据我们所知，这是首个用于验证和纠正文档图像中页级引用的系统基准。基于MP-DocVQA和DUDE构建，它结合了928个经过验证的注入实例和从前沿级和效率级模型中收集的2,468个候选自然错误，其中双标注审计确认1,909个为真实错误。主要标签由确定性分配，而非由大型语言模型法官分配，人类审计作为独立的验证层。在三个模型系列（Gemini、Claude和GPT）中，AtomCite在注入基准上实现了约93%的二进制验证准确率，显著优于所有仅依赖OCR的条件，包括计算匹配的控制组，并在相同OCR文本下超过了所有先前的基于文本的基线。其修复策略将注入混合中的引用精确度从构建的34%提升到87-90%，同时保留了超过90%的正确论点。AtomCite还能迁移：使用冻结提示和零训练，它将两个公开的7-8B模型在五个公共基准上的幻觉检测分数提升到与直接作为法官提示的相同模型相当。最后，审计显示自动标签中的噪声会偏移测量验证器的准确率，并可能反转系统排名，因此仅依赖合成或自动标签的评估可能错误地衡量验证能力。

articles.title: Dynamic Lagging for Simultaneous Translation
articles.abstract: In cascaded simultaneous speech translation, the machine translation (MT) system cannot control the read--write schedule of the upstream recognizer: it must decide, from a growing source prefix, how much target text to commit. We make a sentence-trained, decoder-only LLM prefix-aware by fine-tuning it on stable prefixes---the longest prefix that any translation up to the current partial source has shared with the model's own full-source output---mixed with full-sentence pairs, and prompt it through a single force-decode turn that carries the committed target forward as more source arrives, making the system flicker-free by construction. We fine-tune Qwen3-8B for EN to DE, JA, ZH, simulating the source stream with reference-transcript prefixes. Prefix finetuning preserves full-sentence quality while improving worst-position chunk quality, and it improves calibration of token-level commit confidence, reducing expected calibration error (ECE) on early source prefixes against a stable-prefix oracle. A single training-free threshold on that confidence is the most effective of the three latency controls we compare: it traces a continuous quality--latency frontier that outperforms the discrete wait-$k$ and target-suffix-deletion quality-latency tradeoff mechanisms. The effect holds well on FLEURS, WMT24++, and CoVoST~2 test sets, under both COMET and MetricX.
articles.titleCn: 动态延迟同步翻译
articles.abstractCn: 在级联同步语音翻译中，机器翻译（MT）系统无法控制上游识别器的读写调度：它必须从不断增长的数据前缀中决定要提交多少目标文本。我们通过在稳定前缀（即当前部分源已与模型完整源输出共享的最长前缀）上微调句子训练的、仅解码器的大型语言模型（LLM），使其前缀感知，并结合完整句子对进行微调，并通过一个强制解码轮次提示它，随着更多源输入的到达，将已提交的目标文本向前推进，从而通过设计使系统无闪烁。我们针对英语到德语、日语、中文的Qwen3-8B进行微调，使用参考文本前缀模拟源流。前缀微调在保持完整句子质量的同时提高了最差位置块的质量，并改进了标记级提交置信度的校准，减少了早期源前缀相对于稳定前缀预言机的预期校准误差（ECE）。我们在三种延迟控制方法中比较了这种无训练阈值的置信度，它是最有效的：它描绘了一条连续的质量-延迟前沿，优于离散的等待-k和目标后缀删除的质量-延迟权衡机制。该效果在FLEURS、WMT24++和CoVoST~2测试集上，在COMET和MetricX下均表现良好。

articles.title: Recall Is Not Protection: Evaluating Safety Monitors Against Model Compliance
articles.abstract: Safety monitors screen prompts sent to deployed language models, flagging harmful requests so they are never answered. They are evaluated by recall against harmfulness labels, but a catch only prevents harm if the model would otherwise have complied. We measure the difference directly: we sample repeated responses from the target model, call a harmful prompt \emph{elicitable} if the model complies at least once, and report monitor recall separately on elicitable and non-elicitable prompts. Across six monitor configurations and three model families, spanning activation probes, fine-tuned text guards, and a 120B policy-conditioned reasoning classifier, recall on elicitable prompts falls 0.22 to 0.38 below recall on non-elicitable prompts at a fixed false positive rate. The prompts a monitor misses are 2.8 to 5.6 times more likely to be complied with than the prompts it catches. The gap replicates across three model families and appears also in text-only monitors entirely independent of the target model. This suggests that standard recall may overstate the protection monitors provide in practice, and that monitors should be evaluated against what their models will actually answer.

articles.titleCn: 回忆并非保护：评估安全监控对模型合规性的作用
articles.abstractCn: 安全监控器会筛选部署的语言模型发送的提示信息，标记有害请求，从而确保这些请求不会被回答。它们通过有害性标签进行召回评估，但只有当模型原本会遵从时，这种拦截才能真正防止伤害。我们直接测量这种差异：我们从目标模型中采样重复的响应，如果模型至少遵从一次，就称该有害提示为\emph{可诱导的}，并分别报告在可诱导提示和非可诱导提示上的监控器召回率。在六种监控器配置和三种模型系列中，涵盖激活探针、微调文本守卫和120B策略条件推理分类器，在固定假阳性率下，可诱导提示的召回率比非可诱导提示低0.22至0.38。监控器遗漏的提示比被监控器捕获的提示更有可能被模型遵从，概率高出2.8至5.6倍。这种差距在三种模型系列中都能复制，并且也出现在完全独立于目标模型的纯文本监控器中。这表明标准的召回率可能高估了监控器在实际中提供的保护，监控器应该根据其模型实际会回答的内容进行评估。

articles.title: Bait-and-Recover: Poisoning Internal Refusal Signals to Defend LLMs against White-Box Editing Jailbreaks
articles.abstract: Open-weight large language models face a low-cost white-box threat from representation engineering attacks. Attackers can estimate refusal directions and search for projection-matrix edits that suppress safety alignment while preserving general capabilities, within minutes on a single GPU and without gradient-based training. We propose Bait-and-Recover, a weight-level defense that places a bait adapter where attackers read activations and a paired recovery adapter at the subsequent layer. Trained via gradient routing, this decouples the observation path from the behavior path. By actively poisoning the residual signal used for measurement, Bait-and-Recover disrupts the attacker's edit search, while the recovery layer restores clean downstream computation. Across four open-weight models, our defense raises the minimum refusal rate against white-box edit searches from 16.25% to 71.75% under a strict behavior-preservation budget (KL <= 0.10), with negligible impact on general benchmarks. By invalidating the core measurement assumption of these attacks, observation-path poisoning offers a practical complement to behavior-level safety training.
articles.titleCn: 诱饵与恢复：通过中毒内部拒绝信号来防御LLMs免受白盒编辑越狱攻击
articles.abstractCn: 开放权重的巨型语言模型面临着来自表示工程攻击的低成本白盒威胁。攻击者可以在单个GPU上几分钟内估计拒绝方向，并搜索能够抑制安全对齐同时保留一般能力的投影矩阵编辑，而无需基于梯度的训练。我们提出了诱饵与恢复（Bait-and-Recover）方法，这是一种权重级别的防御机制，在攻击者读取激活值的位置放置一个诱饵适配器，并在下一层放置一个配对的恢复适配器。通过梯度路由进行训练，这种方法将观察路径与行为路径解耦。通过主动污染用于测量的残差信号，Bait-and-Recover会破坏攻击者的编辑搜索，而恢复层则恢复干净的下游计算。在四个开放权重模型上，我们的防御在严格的行為保留预算下（KL <= 0.10），将针对白盒编辑搜索的最低拒绝率从16.25%提高到71.75%，且对一般基准测试的影响可以忽略不计。通过使这些攻击的核心测量假设失效，观察路径污染为行为级别的安全训练提供了一种实用的补充方法。
